title: 我的亿万富翁丈夫只为我下跪

scenes.narration_zh: 你推开公寓大门，Adrian穿着淡粉色围裙跪坐在玄关旁，抬头笑着看你。

dialogue_en.text: Welcome home, sweetheart. I made dinner. May I take your bag?

narration.zh: 周五晚上七点四十二分，私人电梯抵达家门。阿德里安穿着粉色围裙，自愿跪坐在玄关软垫上迎接你。晚餐、温水和拖鞋已经准备好，他先等你回应，再伸手接包。
narration.en: After an afternoon of rain, the private elevator opens onto your warm apartment. Adrian has prepared dinner, slippers and a glass of water; the welcome is an invitation, never a demand.

dialogue.zh: 欢迎回家，亲爱的。我做好晚饭了，可以帮你拿包吗？
dialogue.en: Welcome home, sweetheart. I made dinner. May I take your bag?

scenes.narration_zh: 烛光餐桌前，他用期待的目光等待你的第一口反馈。

dialogue_en.text: Medium rare. Just the way you like it. Well?

narration.zh: 烛光餐桌前，他用期待的目光等待你的第一口反馈。他为自己也摆好了餐具，等你坐稳才坐下。你的真实口味，比一份满分评价更重要。
narration.en: Steak, potatoes and flowers fill the candlelit table. Adrian waits for your first bite, then laughs at his own nervous anticipation; he wants your honest opinion rather than a perfect review.

dialogue.zh: 三分熟，按你喜欢的口味做的。尝起来怎么样？
dialogue.en: Medium rare. Just the way you like it. Well?

dialogue_en.text: May I? Tell me if the pressure is too much.

narration.zh: 晚饭后，你坐在客厅沙发上揉了揉肩。阿德里安拿来温毛巾，在你身旁停下，先问是否需要帮助；他等你同意才会碰触。
narration.en: You settle into the sofa after dinner. Adrian notices your tired shoulders and brings a warm towel, stopping beside you to ask before touching you.

dialogue.zh: 可以吗？力度不舒服就告诉我。
dialogue.en: May I? Tell me if the pressure is too much.

scenes.narration_zh: 他在你腿边安静坐下，请求你评价今天的陪伴。

dialogue_en.text: Was I good today? I really like hearing it from you.

narration.zh: 他在你腿边安静坐下，请求你评价今天的陪伴。他坦白期待表扬，也承认没有得到表扬不代表失去爱。夜晚的陪伴不需要一张家务成绩单。
narration.en: The dishes are put away and the apartment grows quiet. Adrian admits that praise makes him happy, but your answer need not be a reward for domestic work.

dialogue.zh: 我今天做得好吗？我真的很喜欢听你亲口说。
dialogue.en: Was I good today? I really like hearing it from you.

dialogue_en.text: I couldn’t decide what you’d want. Which one wins?

narration.zh: 早晨，三份不同的早餐整齐摆好。阳光落在三份早餐上：蓝莓松饼、法式吐司、班尼迪克蛋。让他推荐，也不等于你从此必须喜欢那一种。
narration.en: Morning sunlight falls across three breakfasts: blueberry pancakes, French toast and eggs Benedict. Adrian grins at the abundance and offers you the first choice.

dialogue.zh: 我拿不准你想吃什么。哪一份能胜出？

dialogue_en.text: Can we make this our thing?

title.en: A Queen and a Willing Heart

narration.zh: 你们保留女性主导的相处方式，也把休息、拒绝与重新协商写进共同约定。阿德里安有自己的事业决定；围裙与迎接仪式只在双方愿意时出现。门再次打开，他先问今天需要什么，而不是完成一场必须得到好评的表演。
narration.en: You keep a female-led relationship with room for rest, refusal and revision. Adrian retains his own career decisions. The apron and greeting rituals happen only by mutual choice. When the door opens, he asks what you want today instead of performing for approval.

title.en: A Home for Both of You

narration.zh: 家务与照顾开始轮流安排。忙碌的一方可以先休息，另一方也能把自己的需要说出来。阿德里安依然会撒娇，也依然喜欢为你做饭，但再没有人必须靠服务换取被爱。
narration.en: You begin sharing care and household work. Whoever is exhausted can rest; both can say what they need. Adrian remains affectionate and enjoys cooking for you, but neither of you has to earn love through service.

narration.zh: 你们没有用一场告白消除职业冲突，而是把工作时段、陪伴时间和各自不可退让的目标逐项谈清。若此前的事业计划不再适合，新的安排须经阿德里安本人同意后再调整。下一次复盘写进日历，爱情与现实都被认真对待。
narration.en: A declaration does not erase incompatible career needs. You negotiate work hours, time together and non-negotiable goals. Any revision to the earlier career plan requires Adrian’s own agreement. A review date goes into the calendar: love and practical reality both receive attention.

narration.zh: 你们选择一起换一种生活节奏，不把搬家或休假当作万能答案。预算、工作交接与试行期限被写清；如果原先决定继续担任总裁，是否改变仍由他确认。你们先过好一段普通日子，再讨论更远的未来。
narration.en: You choose a different rhythm together without treating a move or a holiday as a cure. You agree on budgets, any handover and a trial period. If he previously chose to remain CEO, changing that decision still requires his agreement. You begin with ordinary days before deciding the distant future.

narration.zh: 你选择结束婚姻关系。阿德里安难过，却没有要求最后一次拥抱、继续等待或日后复合。财务与手续交给各自的专业代理处理，私人影像与个人资料按双方要求妥善处理。你走向自己的生活；这不是等待他把你追回来的过场。
narration.en: You choose to end the marriage. Adrian is hurt, but asks for neither a final embrace nor a promise to wait or reconcile. Independent advisers handle practical and financial arrangements, and private recordings and personal data are handled according to your wishes. You move toward your own life. This is not a pause before he wins you back.
